blocks.orig: Ole Serai Luxury Camp – Moru Kopjes is ideally located in central Serengeti in the vicinity of the famous Moru Kopjes and Lake Magadi. The campsite is perched between the Rongai & Nyaroboro Hills, a few meters away from the banks of the Mbalageti and Seronera Rivers, and as such has an abundant variety of resident wildlife as well as a hippo pool a few meters away from the camp. It’s tastefully decorated with all the amenities one would expect in a five-star luxury camp. All 20 luxurious decorated tents are ensuite with flushing toilets, running showers, and a 24-hour power supply. The rooms and the guest areas have been specifically designed to offer an optimum 180-degree view from your bed or while enjoying your meal or drinks, bringing you as close to nature as possible from the covered verandas. These stunning views with the abundance of animals in the vicinity make the experience awe-inspiring.
blocks.html: Ole Serai Luxury Camp – Moru Kopjes enjoys a superb setting in the central Serengeti, near the well-known Moru Kopjes and Lake Magadi. The camp sits between the Rongai & Nyaroboro Hills, just a few metres from the banks of the Mbalageti and Seronera Rivers, so plenty of resident wildlife lives around it, and there’s a hippo pool a few metres from the camp too. The decor is tasteful and you’ll find every amenity you’d expect from a five-star luxury camp. Each of the 20 luxuriously furnished tents has an en-suite bathroom with flushing toilet and running shower, plus power 24 hours a day. The rooms and guest areas were designed specifically to give you an optimal 180-degree view, whether from your bed or over a meal or drink, and the covered verandas bring you as close to nature as possible. With such stunning views and so many animals nearby, the experience is truly awe-inspiring.
